title: Finn 2024 · active interpersonal distance
citation: Finn, D., Cardini, F., Aspell, J. E., Swami, V., & Todd, J. (2024). The impact of body image on social cognition: Fear of negative evaluation mediates the relationship between body surveillance and interpersonal distance in women. Body Image, 51, 101777.
notes: Companion interpersonal-distance assessment from the same cohort as the PPS task. The physical procedure is available for inspection; there is no electronic playback or launchable schedule.

published_method.scope: Companion interpersonal-distance measure in the paper’s single cohort. The active and passive measures precede the separate audio–tactile PPS task.

physical_setup.room: Use the same quiet lab and fixed starting floor markers. The same researcher wore plain black clothing across sessions.
physical_setup.measurement: Measure in centimeters between the outside edges of the start and comfort markers with a tape.

published_method.repetitions: The publication describes one stop placement in each condition and gives no repeat policy.
published_method.task_order: Administer active IPD first. Participant returns to start before passive IPD.
published_method.participant_response: Walk slowly toward the researcher, stop at a comfortable distance and mark the position of the toes.
published_method.researcher_behavior: Look away while the participant approaches until the participant stops.
published_method.analysis: Relate the reported centimeter outcome to body surveillance and fear of negative evaluation. Treat mediation as a cross-sectional association; the published figure and text report different coefficients.

trajectory_path.gap: The manuscript describes measuring between start and stop stickers. It reports the result as preferred IPD. Exact scoring transform or sticker reference point for absolute interpersonal separation is unclear.

task_sequence_rules.value: Slowly approach researcher, self-stop at preferred comfort distance and mark toe position. Return to start.

total_trial_count.gap: One placement is described in each condition. No repeats are specified.

implementation_gaps: Requires a live researcher, marked floor locations, observer-controlled recording of the comfort stop and a physical distance measurement. The audio–tactile playback scheduler has no equivalent task or response field.

The paper does not resolve how the measured start-to-stop marker distance maps to absolute interpersonal separation. Establish and record the reference points and scoring transform before interpreting distances.
The exact room geometry, approach speed and original instruction script are unavailable.
The reported active mediation estimates differ between Fig. 1 and the Results. The original model inputs and outputs are unavailable.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bodyim.2024.101777. Body Image 51, 101777, §§2.1, 2.2.8, 2.3 and §§3.2–3.3; the active mediation estimates also appear in Fig. 1.
